probe.gain_rule: mean gain over best control > SD of gain over 3 seeds

arrays.lag_share: [run, basin, 365] share of |IG| by lag (0 = forecast day t, ECMWF HRES; 1-364 past days), mean over kept test samples of the basin
arrays.group_share: [run, basin, group] share of |IG| by input source incl. static attributes
arrays.memory_L50 / memory_L90: [run, basin] days back holding 50% / 90% of past-phase |IG|, median over the basin's kept samples
arrays.group_lag_0_60: [run, basin, 61, source group] mean |IG| (normalized qmax units) by source and lag 0-60, all samples of the basin
arrays.n_samples / n_samples_all: [basin] kept / all test samples per basin (NaN rows where 0)

demo.units: |IG| in normalized qmax units; x Q_SCALE => mm/day
